Browse and search the source text behind the analytical layers of this project.
Everything shown here respects your current **I've read through...** setting.

<div class="bk-passages-toolbar">

<label>
<span>Part</span>
<select id="bk-passages-part">
<option value="">All visible parts</option>
</select>
</label>

<label>
<span>Book</span>
<select id="bk-passages-book">
<option value="">All visible books</option>
</select>
</label>

<label>
<span>Chapter</span>
<select id="bk-passages-chapter">
<option value="">All visible chapters</option>
</select>
</label>

<label class="bk-passages-search-wrap">
<span>Search visible text</span>
<input id="bk-passages-search"
       type="search"
       placeholder="Search words or phrases...">
</label>

</div>

<div id="bk-passages-status" class="bk-theme-status">
Loading passages...
</div>

<section class="bk-passages-reader">

<div id="bk-passages-results"></div>

<div class="bk-passages-more-wrap">
<button id="bk-passages-more" type="button">
Load more passages
</button>
</div>

</section>
